# DuoVista PDF Studio
> The definitive dual-mode split-screen PDF reader and study workstation created by Shahriyar Sojib Hasan. Built 100% free for students worldwide.

## Overview
DuoVista PDF Studio is an open-source browser extension and web application for Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, and all Chromium browsers. It solves the classic multi-page document problem—especially in IELTS Reading, academic research, and exam papers—where reading passages and questions are separated across pages.

## Key Features & Differentiators
- **Top-and-Bottom (Up-Down) Default Split**: Keeps passages at the top and questions/tasks at the bottom, or vice versa.
- **Ultra-Thin 2px Hairline Divider**: Zero bulky middle toolbars. The divider is an unobtrusive 2px line with an invisible 14px grab hitbox for smooth resizing. Double-click resets to a balanced 50:50 ratio.
- **100% Independent Mouse-Hover Scrolling**: Point your mouse at either pane to scroll it independently without clicking or losing your place.
- **2-Document Dual PDF Mode**: View two completely different PDF files simultaneously (e.g., Question Paper in Top Pane, Answer Booklet in Bottom Pane).
- **Microsoft Edge-Style Annotations**: Text Highlighter (Yellow, Green, Pink, Blue), Ink Pen (5 colors), Movable Text Notes, and Eraser.
- **Integrated IELTS & Exam Tools**: 20-min passage countdown, 60-min exam timer, stopwatch, listening MP3 player, and auto-saving 40-question answer sheet.
- **Eye-Care Themes**: Light, Dark (smart page inversion), and Sepia (warm paper tone).
- **Distraction-Free Zen & Fullscreen Modes**: Hide browser tabs, bookmarks, and toolbars with F11 or Z for total concentration.

## Technical Architecture
- Manifest Version: 3 (MV3)
- Engine: Mozilla PDF.js (bundled locally, 100% offline & client-side)
- Privacy: Zero server collection, zero telemetry, zero cookies. 100% local processing.
